claim: The CreateKey operation has a default request quota of 5 requests per second; KMS request quotas apply to all requests from the principals of an AWS account in a Region, and this quota is adjustable.

evidence.table_header: | Quota name | Default value (requests per second) |

evidence.quote: Throttling is based on all requests on KMS keys of all types in the Region. This total includes requests from all principals in the AWS account, including requests from AWS services on your behalf.
All AWS KMS request quotas are adjustable, except for the AWS CloudHSM key store request quota.
